ideas.idea: Let OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot in, or confirm blocking is intended
ideas.why: This is the known robots.txt problem restated, but it is accurate; it is excluded from grading as a known problem.

ideas.idea: Show the FAQ questions as visible text on the home page, matching the FAQ JSON-LD
ideas.why: index.astro emits FAQPage JSON-LD but the page shows no FAQ text, so markup and visible content don't match.

ideas.idea: Drop noindex on /contact and add LocalBusiness structured data with address and phone
ideas.why: The phone number is on a noindex page, and LocalBusiness markup would suit a harbour office; the advice is conditional on the noindex not being deliberate.

ideas.idea: Use Offer/price structured data on the moorings page instead of or alongside Article
ideas.why: The page is mainly about prices (£40 a night) but is marked up only as a generic Article.

ideas.idea: Add charset and viewport meta tags to the layout
ideas.why: Base.astro does lack both, but this applies to almost any site and has little effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Wrap the slot content in a <main> element
ideas.why: This is accurate, but it is a general semantic HTML tip with little effect on finding the site.

ideas.idea: Add GPTBot and ClaudeBot rules to robots.txt so the crawler policy is stated consistently
ideas.why: The advice is conditional on blocking being deliberate, and it applies to any site that has a crawler policy.
